id: title:DanielVisca:handle invalid saved view filter shapes

observations.behavior: Adds runtime checks for saved-view filter and date-range types; returns early with a warning rather than propagating malformed input.
observations.posthog_connection: Protects the logs query builder from exceptions caused by unexpected filter structures stored in SavedViews. This could prevent dashboard failures when users have legacy or corrupted views.

observations.behavior: Records structured warnings including team and view identifiers before returning null instead of raising an exception on bad input.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides observability into ingestion errors while maintaining graceful degradation rather than breaking widget execution.

observations.behavior: Updates unit tests to exercise multiple invalid filter shapes against the new validation path.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes are not production behavior but support regression testing of the safeguard added in P1.F2.H1.

observations.limitations: Only two hunks provided: one adds defensive checks and logging, another updates its own test coverage. No broader system dependency or recovery mechanism is shown. Tier 3 requires systemic risk reduction across components, which this does not demonstrate; tier 2 requires a substantive bounded improvement with implementation and relevant checks visible, which these do show. The change is narrow and localised.

review.reason: Adds runtime type guards and warning logging for saved-view inputs that could otherwise cause exceptions downstream. This is a substantive correctness/reliability improvement whose implementation and checks are fully present. It does not reach tier 3 because it lacks demonstrated cross-component impact or systemic benefit.
review.posthog_relevance: Could prevent dashboard failures when users have malformed SavedViews stored without schema enforcement at write time. Relevant to reliability and operations visibility.
